page.layout: One page of text; verse epigraph in italic centred at top; running text in one column below; marginal notes in the left margin.

main_text.head: Qualiter in Scythica religatus rupe Prometheus / Assiduam nimio pectore pavit avem, / Nuda Caledonio sic pectora praebuit urso / Non falsa pendens in cruce Laureolus.
main_text.p: Martialis explicatio.Nec satis capiunt, certè non revelant, interpretes. Vult quempiam sustinuisse velut in fabula personam Laureoli: & cum is pro argumento crucifigendus esset, sed in speciem & moris causa: rem ex fabula Titus fecit, & noxium quempiam ita fixit, & fixum bestiis etiam objecit. Dico objecit, atque ita proprie: aliud est, dare ad bestias. Vopiscus in Aureliano: Sane Mnestheus postea surrectus ad stipitem, bestiis objectus est. Surrectus, valet rectus ligatus. Hic est stipes, quem Tertullianus appellat

page.notes: Verse lines and the note "Martialis explicatio" are as printed in the left margin; the marginal mark "Mar-tialis explica-tio" is abbreviated in the scan. Epigraph lines 3 and 4 are partly set in italic with long-s and ligature forms; "urso" in the last letter may be an unusual character. Catchword and signature absent.
